bullets_zh: MOABB v1.7.2修复与pyRiemann均值API的兼容性。
TRCA和TRCSP改用gmean并按关键字传递TRCSP metric，以支持pyRiemann 0.12/0.13-dev。
新增三个TRCSP metric和两个TRCA covariance回归测试。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs.
TRCA and TRCSP now use gmean and pass the TRCSP metric by keyword for pyRiemann 0.12/0.13-dev support.
Adds regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance cases.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.2修复pyRiemann兼容并增强TRCA/TRCSP测试，保障EEG基准稳定。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.2 fixes pyRiemann compatibility and strengthens TRCA/TRCSP tests for stable EEG benchmarks.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs. - Use `gmean` in TRCA and TRCSP, supporting pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions. - Pass the TRCSP metric by keyword to fix fitting with pyRiemann 0.12. - Add regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance means.
